name: Sourdough Loaf
steps: Mix flour and water, rest 30 min (autolyse).
Add starter and salt; mix until combined.
Stretch and fold every 30 min, 4 times.
Shape into a boule and proof (2 h, or overnight in the fridge).
Bake 20 min covered at 245C, then 20 min uncovered at 230C.
notes: 70% hydration. Scale by target_weight_g for a bigger or smaller loaf.
